title: TaskCreatedV1Data
description: Event payload schema for com.system.task.created.v1 worker task execution trigger

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns or requested the task (UUID).

priority.description: Execution priority level for scheduling and worker queue dispatch.

actionPayload.description: Domain-specific execution parameters, payload arguments, or job configuration for worker ingestion.

metadata.description: Operational metadata, correlation tags, client runtime info, or tracing references.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp representing when the task entity was originally created.
